skills.name: gyoza-recipes
skills.description: Create gyoza recipes (llms.txt files) that describe a website's structure for the gyoza browser AI copilot. Use when the user wants to create, write, or generate a recipe, llms.txt, site manifest, or website description for gyoza. Also use when the user asks how to make their website work with gyoza or wants to describe their site's routes, UI elements, and pages for an AI copilot.
